messages:
alex: Hey team — PR #9381 (model-routing: reduce cold-start) needs to land before the deploy freeze on Friday 10:00 PT. CI is failing on linux-integration (flaky test `test_kv_cache_eviction`). Can we get a short rebase/merge window?

maya: I can take a quick look now. If it's only that eviction test it's probably a timing flake. Can you paste the failing log?

alex: Pasted log above in the PR but copied snippet here:
```
FAILED tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_eviction - AssertionError: expected 3 but got 2
```
I just rebased onto main locally and pushed `alex/9381-rebase`. CI run: https://ci.redwood/example/12345

ci-bot: linux-integration started for commit abc123 (PR 9381) — queued on pool `dedicated-gpu-12gb`

ben: +1 to landing if maya gives thumbs. We do have a rebase window at 14:00 PT today, but release-freeze starts Fri 10:00 PT so earlier is better.

maya: Rebase looks fine. I re-ran the flaky job and it passed on rerun. Approving now. :thumbsup:

sophie: Heads-up — if anything touches route-selection we should run the canary smoke after deploy. I can own the canary check.

alex: thanks all — requesting merge. Please coordinate the actual merge time. I can hold the branch until the 14:00 window if ops prefer.

release-bot: Scheduled maintenance/deploy freeze reminder — freeze starts 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Last safe merge window ends 2026-03-18 23:59 PT.

ben: Let's land in the 14:00 PT rebase window and run quick post-merge canary. alex, please squash-and-merge then ping `#eng-oncall` for the canary.

alex: Will do. Squash-and-merge at 14:05 PT, then pinging oncall. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

ci-bot: linux-integration completed: success (after rerun) — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/example/12345/artifacts
